messages:
maria: quick q — our batch embed helper started failing E2 on prod after token-roll; getting 401s for a subset of jobs. Anyone seen auth flakiness with sdk v1.3.2?

kevin: we switched to api-key rotation last week. Are you reading REDWOOD_API_KEY from env or KC store?

maria: env (CI job). logs show `403` for ~20% requests. curl with same key works locally.

sahil: can you paste the request header? sometimes the client strips `Authorization` when proxying; also confirm no trailing spaces in key.

maria: header from CI job:
```
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx...==
Content-Type: application/json
```
no spaces.

liz: saw similar — older SDK had a bug where `requests` session pool reused and caused 403s with rotated keys. Upgrading to 1.3.4 fixed for us.

maria: ah — we're on 1.3.2. I'll try upgrade. Also, unrelated, batch paginator for embeddings is returning vectors of different dims intermittently (512 vs 1536) — same job, same model param.

andre: that's probably the model fallback behavior — if the model named in request isn't available on the node, smart routing falls back to a smaller quantized variant with different embedding dim. Are you explicitly pinning `model` in the embed call?

maria: we pass `model=null` to use default catalog entry. maybe that explains it.

kevin: always specify `model="text-embedding-3-large"` (example) to ensure consistent dims. Also make your client check `meta.model` on response — we added an assertion in helper.

maria: good idea — how to detect mismatch in batch runner? we're doing pagination: page_size=1000, and aggregate.

sahil: for pagination use cursor-based approach. If you do offset+page_size with concurrent workers you can hit race/dup pages. Use the SDK `.list_embeddings(cursor=cursor)` or tracking `next_cursor`. Pseudo:
```
while cursor:
  resp = client.list_embeddings(model="text-embedding-3-large", cursor=cursor, limit=256)
  process(resp.data)
  cursor = resp.next_cursor
```

liz: also add a guard: if len(vec) != expected_dim: log + drop + requeue id for single retry. Don't silently pad.

maria: sample helper snippet we use:
```
def batch_embed(items, model="text-embedding-3-large"):
  out = []
  for chunk in chunked(items, 256):
    resp = client.embeddings.create(model=model, input=[i.text for i in chunk])
    for e in resp.data:
      if len(e.embedding) != MODEL_DIMS[model]:
        raise ValueError(f"dim mismatch {len(e.embedding)} != {MODEL_DIMS[model]}")
      out.append(e)
  return out
```

andre: also watch streaming: streaming emb endpoints can return partials; if your aggregator treats partial batches as full, dims can be off. Ensure you only finalize after `done: true` on stream.

maria: great — one last thing: retries — what's recommended backoff for ephemeral 5xx vs auth 401?

kevin: for 5xx use exponential backoff with jitter, max retries 5. For auth 401/403 don't retry unless you refresh token (rotate) — detect auth errors and trigger token refresh pipeline.

sahil: our helper uses tenacity:
```
@retry(reraise=True, wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=0.5, max=10), stop=stop_after_attempt(5), retry=retry_if_exception_type((ServerError, ConnectionError)))
```

liz: I'll open a small PR with: upgrade SDK to 1.3.4, add explicit model param, add dim-assert and auth-failure hook. @maria can you run canary on staging?

maria: yup will do. thanks :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for pr #421 — build passed :white_check_mark: 

maria: last note — if you see duplicates from pagination it's probably because `created_at` sorting is non-deterministic when items inserted same ms. Use stable sort key (id) or use cursor API.

kevin: thanks all.
